purpose: Define one managed registry of translatable human-facing labels mapped to exact canonical semantic/UI targets.

topics.name: Localization Label Registry
topics.purpose: Define one managed registry of translatable human-facing labels mapped to exact canonical semantic/UI targets.

semantics.registry_rule: Every managed translatable label has an explicit stable label key/identity.
semantics.target_rule: Label maps to an exact canonical semantic or UI target/context.
semantics.source_rule: One canonical source-language value is explicit per label entry.
semantics.translation_rule: Translations are values of the same label identity, not new semantic identities.
semantics.command_rule: Commands/internal identifiers remain English-only and are not translated.
semantics.extraction_rule: Human-facing labels are extracted into the managed registry rather than duplicated as uncontrolled literals.
semantics.authority_rule: Label visibility/translation grants no target authority.

invariants.rule: Localized labels are context-bearing presentation resources mapped to stable canonical identities; translation never changes command names, internal identifiers or semantic identity.

hard_gates.condition: label identity inferred only from source text
same uncontrolled literal duplicated across UI
